summary: 1. The only note edited since Oct 22 (Mining Site Daily Operations Morning Meeting) is already in RAW. 2. Articles updated (Last updated 2026-10-23): daily-production-report, fleet-availability-utilization, survey-volume-reconciliation, q4-recovery-plan-2026, 2027-fleet-budget-capacity-plan, brake-testing, INDEX, QUESTIONS. 3. Files read: 261023-INX-SUM (staged, cloud-only), Oct 22 tabs of the Client Meeting Report, DPR, A&U and Distance Report, Daily Availability Final Report 22-10-2026 (missed by the morning registration), Flash Report #7 (staged), CIP "Fleet Utilization & Reporting integrity" email with its two nested attachments, Milestone Plan Deck v15 (diffed v13-v15), Recovery Plan FINAL_v3, Mixed Scenarios Deck v3, Recovery and 2027 Budget Deck v32, Week 44+45 and November 2026 forecast Summary tabs (v5). 4. Name only: DT Requirement v21, Mixed Scenarios Workbook v3, Milestone Workbook v13, Nov Equipment Availability (Ma'aden), Dispatch Data Reconciliation 22-10, grade control, block info and drill workbooks. 5. Key operational findings Oct 22: trucks 19,375 BCM / 52,313 t vs 24,072 BCM target (-4,697 BCM, -19.5%); survey 19,746 BCM (+371, +1.88%). 6. Ore 7,967 BCM (+3,532 vs target), waste 11,408 BCM (-8,229, -41.9%), strip ratio 1.43. 7. Drilling 2,913 m vs 2,563 m (+350 m). 8. Crusher 3,512 BCM / 9,482 t, 35 min bin-low stops. 9. Survey 261023: cumulative gap -22,575 BCM (-4.09%, -60,953 t), narrowed from -4.31%. MTD survey 551,855 BCM = 83.36% of 661,986; behind pace 65,999 BCM (178,196 t). Needed 55,065 BCM/day (148,677 t/day) for the 2 days left, 2.5x the plan day; at the Oct 22 rate the month ends about 70,639 BCM (190,725 t) short. Lost hours Oct 22, each unit's own BCM/h (t = BCM x 2.7): running units 11.5 h = 3,928 BCM / 10,606 t (EX-123 3 h 1,196 BCM / 3,228 t; EX-263 6 h 1,824 BCM / 4,924 t; EX-262 1.5 h 570 BCM / 1,538 t; EX-340 0.5 h 199 BCM / 537 t; EX-398 0.5 h 140 BCM / 379 t); EX-398 standby 5 h (no material) 1,402 BCM / 3,787 t. Estimates: EX-253 down 24 h at EX-263's 303.92 BCM/h = 7,294 BCM / 19,694 t; EX-247 breakdown 8 h = 2,244 BCM / 6,058 t and 16 h standby "no jobs" = 4,488 BCM / 12,117 t at 280.48 BCM/h. Total 64.5 h = about 19,356 BCM / 52,261 t gross (net miss 4,697 BCM). Basis: excavator availability 74.40% (Final Report, governs), utilization 72% (Client Meeting Report). The Client Meeting Report shows 90% excavator and 97% truck availability the same day. Final Report: trucks 86.96%, drills 79.43%, overall 95.22% / MTD 89.96%. Brake cluster Oct 20-22: DT-110 brake jammed twice (44.75 h down), DT-129 brake air pressure low, LV-48 brake failure (Flash Report #7, near miss, parking brake stopped it, investigation open). EX-123 hydraulic leak open again from 05:00 Oct 23. Joe Coleman (PM) asks Ayman to chair a Fleet Utilization & Reporting integrity meeting. Nested material: 6-Sep deck (two same-input trucks reported 1,116 and 961 BCM) and Sep idle-loss analysis (517.5 h, 34,673 BCM at 67 BCM/h, 29,287 L fuel). Plans: Milestone v15 lands 20.03 Mt; FINAL_v3 20.18 Mt (+181 kt) on data to 21-Oct; Mixed v3 scenario 1b 20.06 Mt; deck v32 adds the 2027 plan (22.5 Mt, 9 excavators, 26 peak trucks). Forecasts v5: Nov 1,955,359 t (67,426 t/day), W44 432 kt, W45 420 kt. Contradictions flagged, not resolved: W44 forecast 432 kt vs Recovery Plan 369 kt vs plan 414 kt; Nov forecast 67,426 t/day on 21 trucks vs prior-pass truck-haul 56,822-58,167 t/day; Client Meeting Report vs Final Report availability; EX-253 downtime start 16-Sep vs 25-Aug; LV-48 absent from the Oct 22 availability table; truck productivity 57.79 vs 53.1 BCM/h. Important References: 47 files re-checked, none new; afternoon section appended to Outputs/important-references-analysis_2026-10-23.md. Part C (Task Feedback Log): query for rows not Processed returned zero. Nothing marked, no questions resolved, no mismatches. Part D (Notes & References): newest row by Last Edited is still Night Shift Handover 2026-10-18 (edited Oct 19). Nothing new or edited. Notion tasks created (Inbox, " [ADW]", no Life Area/Project/dates, no Meeting relation): Review the fleet utilization and reporting integrity attachments before Ayman's meeting (Peter); Explain EX-247 standby of about 16 h after return to service on 22-Oct (Peter); Follow up the LV-48 brake failure investigation (Flash Report #7) with HSEQ and maintenance (unassigned). Caveats. 261023-INX-SUM and Flash Report #7 were cloud-only (not downloaded) on the device and were staged to read. Budget deck v32 was read from the text layer (slides 1-24 shown). The v5 forecasts changed at 11:10 UTC during the pass; headline totals re-read after the change and unchanged.
